_comment: Parking Areas: static social rooms reached with the in-game !pa command.
index    0-based slot. Also picks the thumbnail the client shows for this place:
index 0 is pa_wmp01 in data/TEX/pa_new.MIA, index 10 is pa_wmp11.
placeid  Written to the client's place global at 0x006F64C0 by the 0x0482 warp.
The junction table at 0x00444a1a assigns 0x09..0x13 to these eleven
places, so leave these alone unless you know what you are changing.
name     Shown in chat and in !pa list. Max 15 characters, longer names are cut.
The real-world names are not stored anywhere in the client, so they ship generic.
Enter each one in game, look at the backdrop, and rename it here.
